content.premise: The sky is clearing at sundown and the first frost will come down the valley tonight. The head gardener has burnt her hand, so she asks her visitors to shut the conservatory and light the stove below it before the old lemon tree freezes.
content.theme: A walled kitchen garden on an upland shelf, with a glass conservatory against its north wall, a lamplit potting room beside it and a stove cellar underneath.
content.title: The Glasshouse
